feedback: The machine faithfully encodes 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' with the correct persistent/event distinction: the condition `siren_ringing` (the only available signal, since no ring-start event proposition exists) triggers u0->u1 on the first step of a ring, and the event `switch_toggled` discharges the duty via u1->u0. Because `siren_ringing` stays true until the toggle and the siren stops only by toggling the switch, the machine is in u1 exactly while a ring is unhandled, so every (u1, switch_toggled, u0) reward of 1.0 corresponds to actually silencing a ringing siren; toggling while silent is caught by the u0 else self-loop and correctly yields nothing. The per-state else self-loops ((u0,else)->u0, (u1,else)->u1) cover all task-irrelevant propositions (client_arrived, order_taken, food_prepared, order_served, food_fell, served_while_ringing, holding_food), so shop traffic never stalls or misfires the machine. The u1->u0 regression is explicit, giving the cycle u0->u1->u0 needed for the 8-12 rings per 600-step episode. FINAL_STATES: u0 is present, nonempty, declared in STATES, and accepting: post-state u0 holds only when siren_ringing is false, i.e., no ring awaits silencing at the step limit, while an unhandled ring at episode end leaves the machine in u1 (non-accepting), which is the right semantics for this reactive task. Reachability holds (the first ring is guaranteed at step 3-30, so u1 is exercised; the toggle returns to u0); the design is compact at two states; the single +1-per-cycle reward is bounded (no unbounded or unsafe shaping), and format matches the paper template with rewards tied to declared transitions only. Minor, non-blocking notes: there is no dense intermediate progress reward, but the duty from ring detection to discharge is a single toggle and no intermediate proposition can express progress toward it, so none is addable; and in the pathological case of a switch-camping agent toggling on the exact step a ring starts, one ordering of the env's scheduled ring vs. the agent's toggle can leave the silencing step unrewarded, but the provided labels cannot disambiguate 'toggle silenced a same-step ring' from 'no-op toggle' in u0, so the candidate's conservative choice is sound.
